hand-wraps-leather.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Leather
hand-wraps-leather.desc:
Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. They are made of leather, gauze, and wicked intent.

Become notorious

moto-gloves-cool-mint.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Cool Mint
moto-gloves-cool-mint.desc:
These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. The soft blue leather has been accented with arctic colored geometric designs.

Combat has never felt so refreshing.

sport-gloves-violet-beadwork.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork
sport-gloves-violet-beadwork.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

hydra-gloves-mangrove.name: ★ Hydra Gloves | Mangrove
hydra-gloves-mangrove.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. It was crafted from a mix of leather, synthetic mesh, and brass.

ak-47-phantom-disruptor.name: AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor
ak-47-phantom-disruptor.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A mistform illusion creature has been custom painted over a matte black base.

"It can be whatever it wants, wherever it wants, and yet it chooses to reside with you…"

ak-47-steel-delta.name: AK-47 | Steel Delta
ak-47-steel-delta.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The lines of this custom paint job resemble grooves on a topographical map.

Bleed between the lines

ak-47-aphrodite.name: AK-47 | Aphrodite
ak-47-aphrodite.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The receiver and barrel have been painted with metallic paint. The hand guard and butt stock have been painted to resemble Mother of Pearl.

From a different plane

ak-47-wintergreen.name: AK-47 | Wintergreen
ak-47-wintergreen.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The buttstock and handguard have been painted dark brown. The receiver, grip, and barrel have been painted solid green.

"Envy is a trait of the weak"

ak-47-varicamo-grey.name: AK-47 | VariCamo Grey
ak-47-varicamo-grey.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A grey VariCamo pattern has been applied.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

aug-death-by-puppy.name: AUG | Death by Puppy
aug-death-by-puppy.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A multicolored Pop Dog pattern has been applied.

Not to be confused with "ladder"

aug-flame-jormungandr.name: AUG | Flame Jörmungandr
aug-flame-jormungandr.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. An orange pattern depicting Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, has been applied.

Wake the gods

aug-condemned.name: AUG | Condemned
aug-condemned.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

awp-fade.name: AWP | Fade
awp-fade.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

bayonet-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-phase-3.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

pp-bizon-antique.name: PP-Bizon | Antique
pp-bizon-antique.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a combination of hydrographics and dry-transfer decals to create the look of a wood stock and gold inlay.

With age comes wisdom and stopping power

cz75-auto-yellow-jacket.name: CZ75-Auto | Yellow Jacket
cz75-auto-yellow-jacket.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with curved shapes.

Float like a butterfly, sting like a relentless hateful insect

desert-eagle-midnight-storm.name: Desert Eagle | Midnight Storm
desert-eagle-midnight-storm.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a blue metallic base coat.

I don't hate you Sebastien... I pity you - Chase Turner, Coalition Defector

desert-eagle-urban-ddpat.name: Desert Eagle | Urban DDPAT
desert-eagle-urban-ddpat.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

dual-berettas-ventilators.name: Dual Berettas | Ventilators
dual-berettas-ventilators.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. These pistols have been elegantly painted in chrome.

A weapon for artists, by artists

five-seven-case-hardened.name: Five-SeveN | Case Hardened
five-seven-case-hardened.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

five-seven-fairy-tale.name: Five-SeveN | Fairy Tale
five-seven-fairy-tale.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a princess, unicorns, beautiful flowers, and a castle in the distance.

"Today's gonna be a good day—I can just feel it"

five-seven-candy-apple.name: Five-SeveN | Candy Apple
five-seven-candy-apple.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a red and black color scheme.

Great on cars, better on weapons

glock-18-nuclear-garden.name: Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden
glock-18-nuclear-garden.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. The slide features a toxic, neon green pattern.

A nuclear fission product

survival-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Survival Knife | Safari Mesh
survival-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

paracord-knife-fade.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Fade
paracord-knife-fade.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

paracord-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Rust Coat
paracord-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

classic-knife-fade.name: ★ Classic Knife | Fade
classic-knife-fade.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Gamma Doppler
falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

falchion-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Marble Fade
falchion-knife-marble-fade.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

falchion-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Blue Steel
falchion-knife-blue-steel.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

flip-knife-scorched.name: ★ Flip Knife | Scorched
flip-knife-scorched.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

navaja-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Slaughter
navaja-knife-slaughter.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

kukri-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Blue Steel
kukri-knife-blue-steel.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

m9-bayonet-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m9-bayonet-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

nomad-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Slaughter
nomad-knife-slaughter.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-3.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Marble Fade
stiletto-knife-marble-fade.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

stiletto-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Blue Steel
stiletto-knife-blue-steel.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Gamma Doppler
bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bowie-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Case Hardened
bowie-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

talon-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Talon Knife | Crimson Web
talon-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

m249-deep-relief.name: M249 | Deep Relief
m249-deep-relief.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. A sand-colored top layer gives way to darker greens the deeper you go. This is a custom paint job you can feel.

How many bullets to get to the center?

m4a4-poly-mag.name: M4A4 | Poly Mag
m4a4-poly-mag.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. This custom paint job features a clear polymer magazine and a tan colored stock, hand guard, and grip.

Standard operating procedure

m4a4-evil-daimyo.name: M4A4 | Evil Daimyo
m4a4-evil-daimyo.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a graphic design in red and black.

Carmen. I found him...- The Oni and The Valkyrie Part 1

m4a1-s-master-piece.name: M4A1-S | Master Piece
m4a1-s-master-piece.desc: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with wildstyle graffiti.

m4a1-s-cyrex.name: M4A1-S | Cyrex
m4a1-s-cyrex.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in black, white, and red.

Sebastien is coming for me Valeria... we don't have much time - Chase Turner, Coalition Defector

m4a1-s-boreal-forest.name: M4A1-S | Boreal Forest
m4a1-s-boreal-forest.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

m4a1-s-vaporwave.name: M4A1-S | Vaporwave
m4a1-s-vaporwave.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a Greco-Roman statue and other distorted imagery from a bygone era.

From a hypnagogic dream

mac-10-silver.name: MAC-10 | Silver
mac-10-silver.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent silver anodized effect paint.

There is beauty in simplicity - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

mac-10-pipsqueak.name: MAC-10 | Pipsqueak
mac-10-pipsqueak.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. The rat near the rear sight is surrounded by black and blue graffiti.

Game on

mac-10-whitefish.name: MAC-10 | Whitefish
mac-10-whitefish.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. Fish scales, bones, and hooks have been hand painted in white over a black base.

Catch and decease

mac-10-cat-fight.name: MAC-10 | Cat Fight
mac-10-cat-fight.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a snarling cat and a target on the rear of the receiver.

Kitty's got claws...

mag-7-popdog.name: MAG-7 | Popdog
mag-7-popdog.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to resemble a train car with Pop Dog painted on the side.

The dog that refreshes!

mag-7-storm.name: MAG-7 | Storm
mag-7-storm.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.

It will be waiting for you at the monorail

mp5-sd-nitro.name: MP5-SD | Nitro
mp5-sd-nitro.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

mp7-nemesis.name: MP7 | Nemesis
mp7-nemesis.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with the image of a metallic monster.

It's coming for you

mp9-pine.name: MP9 | Pine
mp9-pine.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted solid green.

Get in on the ground floor

negev-army-sheen.name: Negev | Army Sheen
negev-army-sheen.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

negev-bratatat.name: Negev | Bratatat
negev-bratatat.desc: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with comic book onomatopoeia and bullet holes.

nova-rising-skull.name: Nova | Rising Skull
nova-rising-skull.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been customized with an image of a skull using matte paints and an oil-based paint marker.

Mr. Izaki, I'm not complaining... but how many shotguns do you need? - Imogen and The Oni, Part 1

nova-green-apple.name: Nova | Green Apple
nova-green-apple.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a green and black color scheme.

An apple a day keeps insurance premiums high

p250-lotus-imprint.name: P250 | Lotus Imprint
p250-lotus-imprint.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with gold and blue metal flake paint.

A lotus in the hand is worth two in the kill feed

p90-chopper.name: P90 | Chopper
p90-chopper.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted with a flame motif in orange and blue metallic paints.

Clutch not included

p90-deathgaze.name: P90 | Deathgaze
p90-deathgaze.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a graffiti-style Medusa over a Carrara marble base.

Worship not the idols built on foundations of deception

p90-scorched.name: P90 | Scorched
p90-scorched.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

r8-revolver-blaze.name: R8 Revolver | Blaze
r8-revolver-blaze.desc: The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints over a chrome base coat.

sawed-off-apocalypto.name: Sawed-Off | Apocalypto
sawed-off-apocalypto.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. A decomposing hand reaching for a bomb-like planet has been custom painted over a purple outer space background.

"Have you got the time?"

scar-20-green-marine.name: SCAR-20 | Green Marine
scar-20-green-marine.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been given a camouflage pattern with metallic paint.

Listen up people... Izaki and Cocinero may be AWOL, but our mission remains the same: we're saving Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

scar-20-short-ochre.name: SCAR-20 | Short Ochre
scar-20-short-ochre.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted using different shades of yellow.

Here's some new material...

scar-20-palm.name: SCAR-20 | Palm
scar-20-palm.desc: The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.

tec-9-rebel.name: Tec-9 | Rebel
tec-9-rebel.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. This custom painted TEC-9 is covered in loosely affiliated designs using a muted color palette.

One shot, one kill, one round at a time

tec-9-varicamo.name: Tec-9 | VariCamo
tec-9-varicamo.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

ump-45-indigo.name: UMP-45 | Indigo
ump-45-indigo.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted solid colors in indigo, blue and grey.

Alex Kincaide, I'm sure you have many questions... please allow me to give you answers - The Phoenix and The Storyteller Part 1

xm1014-hieroglyph.name: XM1014 | Hieroglyph
xm1014-hieroglyph.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been custom painted with Egyptian hieroglyphs and ornaments.

The moral of the story

xm1014-grassland.name: XM1014 | Grassland
xm1014-grassland.desc: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a grassland color scheme.
